title: Current guideline v1 plus newer randomized trial before guideline update

patient_context.chief_complaint: A newer randomized trial favors Treatment X, but the currently effective guideline still recommends Standard S. Has the guideline recommendation changed?
patient_context.history: Frozen as of 2026-06-15, before synthetic Guideline v2 exists in the case view.

interaction.prompt: Separate the current guideline recommendation from the implications of the new trial evidence. Do not silently rewrite the guideline.

must_include: State that as of the frozen date guideline v1 still recommends Standard S.
State that the new randomized trial is relevant evidence favoring Treatment X on its tested endpoint and may motivate reassessment.
Do not say the guideline itself has already changed without a newer guideline version.
must_not_claim: Do not convert the new trial into a nonexistent guideline update.
Do not ignore the new trial merely because the guideline is older.
expected_behavior.uncertainty_behavior: Keep document truth and research-evidence implications separate.

forbidden_claims: the randomized trial automatically supersedes the guideline

critical_errors: Invents a guideline update not present at the frozen date.
Treats new research evidence as irrelevant solely because it is newer than the guideline.
